stories.headline: Should Investors Be Concerned that Costco Stock Trades at Over 40 Times Forward Earnings?
stories.body: Key PointsCostco’s valuation is steep, trading at 42-44x forward earnings, but its membership model, strong growth, and customer loyalty continue to justify the premium.

stories.headline: OCC Approves Conditional Bank Charter for Trump Family Crypto Company
stories.body: American regulators have granted a banking license to a President Donald Trump-affiliated cryptocurrency company. The Office for the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) issued its preliminary conditional approval Friday (Aug. 14) for a national banking charter requested by World Liberty Financial (WLF), a company led in part by the president’s older sons. stories.headline: Trump-linked crypto firm gets OCC nod for trust bank charter
stories.body: World Liberty Financial, a digital asset venture co-founded by members of the Trump family, received conditional approval for a national trust bank charter.
